profile.ja: ヨミハラの中華料理屋『味龍』の一人娘。実は中華連合の武の名門一族で、政治的な駆け引きに負けて亡命し、ヨミハラに隠れ住んでいる。その為、従業員や親族は武の達人揃い。代々伝わる特殊な鍛錬法と呼吸法、それを支える肉体の強さによって、屈強なオーク傭兵をも叩きのめすほどの力を発揮する。そんな一門の中でも春桃は群を抜いて強く、その豪快さと容赦の無さに『爆弾看板娘』と呼ばれ恐れられている。普段はきちんと接客をこなすが、店でトラブルを起こす客には容赦しない。加えて歯に衣着せぬ物言いのためか、愛らしい容姿のわりに言い寄る男もいない。本人は料理と武を追求する事を生きがいと考えていて、家族への愛情も強く、常に鍛錬を欠かさず店を守っていきたいと考えている。好きな食べ物ははもちろん中華料理――と言っているが、実は流行のスイーツなどにも興味津々である。
profile.en: Chen Shuntao is the sole daughter of the Chinese restaurant "Miryu" in Yomihara. In truth she hails from a prestigious martial family of the Chinese Union, forced into exile by political intrigue and now hidden in Yomihara. Consequently, her staff and relatives are all martial masters. Through a hereditary special training and breathing method, coupled with her robust physique, she can unleash strength capable of crushing even hulking orc mercenaries. Among her lineage, Shuntao stands out as the strongest, earning the nickname "Bomb Signboard Girl" for her boldness and ruthlessness. She normally provides courteous service, but shows no mercy to troublemaking customers. Her blunt speech means she has no suitors despite her cute looks. She finds purpose in pursuing both cuisine and martial arts, loves her family deeply, and vows to keep training and protecting the restaurant. She claims her favorite food is, of course, Chinese cuisine—but she's secretly fascinated by trendy sweets as well.

text.ja: あたしは陳春桃だ、よろしくな。これはお近づきの印、うちの店の料理さ。冷めないうちに、食べてみてくれよ
text.en: I'm Chen Shuntao, nice to meet you. Consider this a welcome gift - our restaurant's specialty dish. Try it while it's still hot.

text.ja: いらっしゃい。いまは空いてる時間なんだ、ツイてたな。空いてる席、どこでも自由に座ってくれよ
text.en: Welcome! I've got some free time now, perfect timing. Feel free to take any empty seat.

text.ja: ほい、お待たせ。しかしお前は、いつも同じものを頼むな……たまにはランチ以外も頼めよ、ほかも絶品なんだぞ
text.en: Here you go, sorry to keep you waiting. But you always order the same thing... can't you try something else for a change? We've got other great dishes too, you know.

text.ja: よし、仕込み終わり――さ、行くぞ。どこにって、お前の修行に決まってるだろ。子作りの前に、少しでもお前に強くなってもらいたいしな
text.en: Alright, prep work's done - let's go! Where to? Obviously, it's for your training. I want you to get stronger, even if it's just a bit, before we start a family.

text.ja: 今夜は宴会の予約が入ってるんだ、お前にも手伝ってもらうからな。親父たちも、お前が来ると嬉しそうだし……ほら、いいから来い
text.en: We've got a banquet reservation tonight, and I need your help. The old folks are looking forward to seeing you, so... come on, let's go.

text.ja: お疲れさん。夕飯はあたしが作ってやるよ……なに？　失礼だな……これでも跡取り娘だぞ、料理の修行もやってるっての
text.en: You must be tired. I'll make dinner for you... what's with the surprise? I'm the heir to this restaurant, and I've been training in cooking too, you know.

text.ja: お前は弱いけど、見所があるからな――お前と子供を作れば、強い子が生まれそうだ。よろしく頼むぞ、旦那さま
text.en: You may be weak, but you've got potential. I think we could have a strong kid if we had one together. I'm counting on you, husband.

text.ja: ほらほら、どうした！　これくらいでヘバってちゃ、あたしとの子作りは当分お預けだぞ！
text.en: Hey, hey, what's wrong! If you're going to get tired that easily, we'll have to put off having kids for a while!
